scenes.headline: How MusaCoder learns to write GPU kernels
scenes.sub: Execution-feedback RL, a correctness-first reward, and three stabilizers.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Gecko! MusaCoder turns PyTorch code into hand-written GPU kernels. Training it on execution feedback nearly falls apart. Here's how it's held together.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: Learn kernels from a compiler and a verifier, and fix the three ways that RL breaks: sparse rewards, multi-turn hacking, and off-policy drift.
scenes.mark: the three ways that RL breaks
scenes.say: Learn kernels from a compiler and a verifier, and fix the three ways that training breaks: sparse rewards, multi-turn hacking, and off-policy drift.

scenes.title: A reward that makes cheating pointless

parts.note: no compile, a crash, or a PyTorch fallback
parts.say: A kernel that doesn't compile, crashes, or quietly calls PyTorch scores minus one. Cheating counts as crashing.

parts.note: q is the share of tests passed; still negative
parts.say: Partly correct earns a bounded score that's still negative, so the model can climb.

parts.note: only a fully correct, legal kernel crosses zero
parts.say: Only a fully correct, legal kernel crosses zero. Then speed earns a bonus.

scenes.title: The RL loop and its three fixes

steps.say: The model writes a kernel. MooreEval compiles it, runs it and checks it. A failure comes back with its error log, for another turn.
Fix one, PrimeEcho. Rewarding the best turn teaches the model to ship broken first drafts, so the reward stays anchored to turn one.
Fix two. When every sample in a group fails, there's no gradient. So failures become repair tasks, buffered and mixed back in.
Fix three, MirrorPop. Drift that cancels out on average slips past the usual filter. Averaging its absolute size catches it.

scenes.title: Ablation: Pass@8 as each fix is removed
scenes.note: on KernelBench, under the authors' own protocol
scenes.say: Take any fix away and the score drops. MirrorPop matters most. On the authors' own benchmark, the full model leads every frontier model they tested.

scenes.text: Kernel RL fails in three nameable ways. The contribution is a targeted fix for each.
scenes.say: Kernel-writing RL fails in three nameable ways. The contribution is a targeted fix for each.

recap: A reward where cheating equals crashing
Correct first; speed is still the hard part
scenes.say: To recap: a correctness-first reward, three stabilizers, and speed as the part still to win.
